test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 3 Feb 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

The shopkeeper assured me about the freshness of the vegetables.

options.text: I had been assured by the shopkeeper about vegetables being freshness of the vegetables.
I was being assured about the freshness of the vegetables by the shopkeeper.
I was assured about the freshness of the vegetables by the shopkeeper.
I am assured by the shopkeeper about the freshness of the vegetables.

solution:
The correct answer is **"I was assured about the freshness of the vegetables by the shopkeeper".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is the active form of Past Indefinite Tense. It will change into passive form after adding **was/were + V³ **in the sentence.
 
• **Past Indefinite Tense :**
 
 
• Active : Subject + V² + Object
 
• Passive : **Subject (Objective Case) + Was/were + V³ + by + Object (Subjective Case)**
 
• **For example : **Active : Raju gave him a pencil.
